_doc: Genes that have not been shown to fire in any committed screen, and why.
The shape is `tools/inert_waivers.json`'s: a flat {tag: reason} map. Unlike
that file the reason is ENFORCED -- `tools/gene_fires.py` fails a waiver
shorter than 40 characters -- and a waiver goes STALE, failing the same
`--max 0` ratchet, the moment its gene is proven by a committed screen row
or leaves the gene tables. The list can only shrink.
Almost every entry here is grandfathered: it was in the tables before a new
gene had to show it fires. A gene added AFTER 2026-08-23 should not appear
here at all -- #2330 wrote rows for eighteen behaviours, the gate refused
four of them on their own probes, and those four were removed from the
To clear an entry: run a single-gene probe, which holds every other gene at
the baseline so any divergence is this gene alone, and commit the analysis --
-- then DELETE the entry here, or the stale-waiver check fails.

waivers.escort-cap-holds: The whole path it changes -- `AdvancedAi::stacked_escort_pace` -- returns None on its first line unless `formationless_settler_escort()` is true, and that reads `live_formationless_settler_shadow`, a Kind::HostOnly gene that `gene_screen` excludes from its table and holds off in every seat (`enable_engine_repairs_universe` sets only Repair rows). A native board therefore cannot reach either branch this gene gates, exactly as the `escort-patience-runs-out` row two lines above it in the registry records for the same reason -- that one is HostOnly; this one stays OptIn because the operator arms it as a labelled live `--with` arm, which only a held-off opt-in can seat. Its own 24-game probe (seeds 41100000..) was run and its row is pure chair noise: under today's independent draw an inert gene no longer produces the exact-zero signature this gate was written against, so committing that row would assert firing the run cannot show. The live ladder measures it directly and at high frequency -- the opening-abandon rule it targets fires on 45% of King games. Clear this waiver when the escort path is reachable on a native board, or when the gene is retired.
waivers.science-expansion-phase: Its single-gene 24-game probe is queued behind the operator's 08-28 halt: all gene tournaments on this machine were stopped because it runs the live Civ 6 verification ladder, and a question that needs a screen stays documented, not tested, until the operator resumes them. The gene IS screenable on a native board -- it gates on the Science victory target inside `land_grab`'s `desired_cities` arm, both reachable in a screen -- so this is a queued probe, not an unreachable path, and it ships default-off. Clear this waiver by running the probe from the _doc above (`--genes science-expansion-phase`) and committing the analysis to docs/gene_screens/fires/science-expansion-phase.json the moment tournaments resume.
